sentence_stem: If only I had studied harder,
correct_completion: I would have passed the exam.
full_sentence: If only I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
acceptable_variants: I would have done much better.
my results would have been higher.

options.why_wrong: This states a real past event, but the wish expresses regret about something that did not happen.

options.text: I would have passed the exam.
I will study harder next time.
options.why_wrong: This makes a future promise, while 'if only' expresses regret about the past.

options.text: I would pass the exam tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This refers to the future, but the stem talks about a past action that did not happen.

grammar_focus: Third conditional after 'if only' to express past regret
explanation: After 'if only' with a past perfect clause, the main clause uses 'would have' plus the past participle to express an unreal past result.
translation: Gdybym tylko uczył się bardziej, zdałbym egzamin.
